title: Authoritative apartment-planning foundation
description: M0–M7.7 established millimetre geometry, derived rooms and areas, semantic history, local projects, reference calibration, editable recognition, read-only 3D, bounded planning, geometry inspection and explainable furniture fit.

title: Recognition quality under corrective review
description: M7.8A established and accepted the public-safe benchmark. M7.8B then failed product-owner review on a representative real plan: the Draft contained 417 local wall candidates, zero openings and a symbol/furniture network. Structural masking and fail-closed overload handling are now being developed; the PR remains Draft and must not be treated as accepted recognition quality.

title: Architectural shell before semantic expansion
description: Add a public-safe clutter-heavy regression, keep candidate counts reviewable, prevent symbol networks from outranking the shell, repeat real-plan acceptance, and only then continue with verified host-wall openings, room faces, labels, areas and confidence calibration.
